verdict.rationale: Clerk's first-party docs describe Enterprise SSO that lets users sign in with their IdP credentials, naming Azure AD (Entra), Okta and Google Workspace, with user data synchronized into Clerk. The docs also state that SAML and OIDC are both supported protocols. missing for 10: per-IdP setup or configuration documentation beyond overview statements, detail on workforce-specific controls (e.g. domain enforcement or provisioning), and independent or hands-on corroboration that these connections work in practice.
